description: The dataset contains 20 observations of water isotope measurements collected during four research expeditions in the Mackenzie region. Each record includes latitude, longitude, timestamp, station identifier, water depth, δ¹⁸O and δD isotope ratios, and a derived metric d xs. Latitude values range up to 69.649° north and longitude down to –137.8048° west. Depths are shallow (0–1 m) and isotope values span –20.32 to 0 ‰ for δ¹⁸O and –161.9 to 0 ‰ for δD. The data serve climate and geochemical analyses, supporting studies of spatial and temporal patterns in water isotopes, hydrology, and paleoclimate reconstruction and environmental monitoring.
